facts.scope: Generic device information; no case-specific repair target.
facts.statement: EN high enables the chip, EN low disables it; the EN input must not float.
facts.subject: ESP32-C3-WROOM-02/02U EN

facts.scope: Generic device information; no case-specific repair target.

source.locator: Table 4-1 and accompanying text, printed p12

facts.statement: GPIO9 defaults to a weak pull-up at reset when external circuitry is absent or high-impedance; external drive and reset sampling conditions matter.
facts.subject: ESP32-C3 strapping inputs

facts.scope: Generic device information; no case-specific repair target.
facts.statement: 45 kohm is a typical internal weak pull-up/down value at 3.3 V and 25 C, not a guaranteed minimum or maximum.
facts.subject: ESP32-C3 internal pull resistors

facts.scope: Generic device information; no case-specific repair target.
facts.statement: An EN RC delay is advised; 10 kohm and 1 uF are usual recommended values, to be adjusted for actual supply rise and reset timing.
facts.subject: ESP32-C3-WROOM-02/02U EN timing

facts.scope: Generic device information; no case-specific repair target.
facts.statement: The guide recommends reserving series resistors with initial values 22/33 ohm and optional initially unpopulated shunt capacitors near the chip; this is a design recommendation.
facts.subject: ESP32-C3 USB design

facts.scope: Generic device information; no case-specific repair target.
facts.statement: The guide recommends an external GPIO9 pull-up and warns against high-value capacitors there. This does not erase its default internal pull-up.
facts.subject: ESP32-C3 GPIO9 design

facts.scope: Generic device information; no case-specific repair target.
facts.statement: ADDR must not float. Logic low selects 7-bit address 0x44; logic high selects 0x45. Keep its level stable throughout an I2C transaction.
facts.subject: SHT3x-DIS ADDR

facts.scope: Generic device information; no case-specific repair target.
facts.statement: Unused nRESET is recommended to float or connect to VDD through at least 2 kohm; it has an internal typical 50 kohm pull-up.
facts.subject: SHT3x-DIS nRESET

facts.scope: Owner-approved ordinary project-source observation (not an immutable requirement).
facts.statement: The driver source defines DEFAULT_ADDR as 0x44; application source assigns SHT_ADDR from that constant. This is a static source observation, not proof of deployed firmware or a human-approved immutable requirement.
facts.subject: Current project firmware source
